result_summary: Cap-evolve implements a useful run-local terminal-test crash guard: if TEST evidence was locally persisted but the final seal was not committed, a retry is refused to prevent a second look. The audited path still lacks a pre-dispatch logical evaluation authority for provider-accepted-before-first-local-outcome, does not resume partial TEST cells, does not mechanically prevent Read/Bash access to sealed artifacts in the Claude plugin, and does not make the lockbox terminal across separate runs. Its adaptive VAL gate is fixed-look paired-SE rather than anytime-valid/candidate-crossing online-error controlled.
